description: DEPRECATED - superseded by ai.bithuman:essence2-android (https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/ai.bithuman/essence2-android). This final release is 2.3.6's code unchanged (the same classes.jar and native libraries) plus the third-party notices it lacked: FFmpeg 6.1 (LGPL-2.1-or-later, statically linked; written relink offer in META-INF/LGPL-RELINK-OFFER.txt, covering 1.12.1 onwards), OpenSSL, libcurl, HDF5, libjpeg-turbo, libwebp and KISS FFT, with ONNX Runtime and libc++ alongside. See META-INF/NOTICE.txt.
